title: Clearer names for a few screens
summary: A few screens now use the same name everywhere: in the menus, page titles and Help.
items: The DM's home screen is called the Desk on the page too (it used to say Campaign control).
Shop Management is now Shop schedules: it sets opening days and restocks, while shops themselves are run from Market.
Downtime is now Time & downtime, for DMs and players alike.
Old links and bookmarks still open the same screens.
